items.title: Ikoku Nikki
items.overview: Makio Kodai (35), a novelist, cannot bear to see her niece Asa (15) being passed around by relatives at the funeral of her sister and her husband, and decides to take her in on the spur of the moment. However, although she took her niece home, she came to her senses the next day and her natural shyness kicked in. Makio had forgotten how unsuitable she was to live with someone. Asa, on the other hand, is not shy and agrees to live with Maki, an "adult who is not like an adult," in an unusual but honest way. This is the story of when two polar opposite worlds awkwardly try to interact.

Bạn thân của chị gái tôi thật phiền phức
items.overview:
High school freshman Nao Misumi has known Sena Ikuta, his older sister Rio’s best friend, since he was in elementary school. As a self-proclaimed “sister’s boy”, Nao has always found Sena’s over-familiarity incredibly annoying. Yet, despite being loud, airheaded, and having zero sense of personal space, he could never truly bring himself to hate her. She has always looked out for him just as much as she has for Rio. 

She’s a total idiot, too carefree, and her sense of personal space is completely broken. To Nao, she’s supposed to be nothing more than a nuisance, and yet... 

“At first, I hated her for sure. She was noisy, and always took the things I cherished. So why is it that now—?” 

Even as he grumbles about her constantly calling him “Lil bro," he finds himself unable to leave her alone. How did this “annoying” fixture in his life become the one person he can’t look away from?

items.title: Kodomo Dorobou
items.overview:
Minori is the only daughter of the Sano family, a family that is the picture of happiness. 

One day, Minori returns home after cheerfully forgetting something as usual, and encounters a burglar who has been breaking into the house. She falls from the balcony, and to her surprise, she and the thief switch bodies!

Until they get each other's bodies back, they begin a strange four-person life: father, mother, daughter, and thief.

A disturbing, heartwarming comedy begins!

items.overview:
The Fors family is a prestigious lineage of swordsmen and a prominent noble house ruling the southern domain of the kingdom. Born as their third son, Nova endured a harsh childhood, branded a failure due to his utter inability to wield the exclusive power inherent to their bloodline. Even after reaching adulthood and being granted a small territory, he is burdened with virtually zero duties and zero expectations from his family and the people around him.

However, an unexpected marriage proposal finds its way to Nova. The other party belongs to a great noble house that rules the northern domain—the Archgate family, which is currently at the height of its prosperity despite a long-standing feud with the Fors family. Furthermore, his prospective bride is, astonishingly, the head of the Archgate family herself, Chia...

"I have been in love with you... ever since that time."

Thus, the third son of the Fors family, a man who possesses nothing, finds himself welcoming a wife of excellent character and stunning beauty—or rather, a wife who is simply perfect in every regard. She is a woman destined to change Nova's fate, determined to give him everything.

"People say all sorts of terrible things about the head of the Archgate family—that she is terrifying, cold-blooded, and ruthless. But Chia is cute, kind, smart, and absolutely perfect."

This marks the beginning of the married life between the easygoing Nova, and Chia, who reveals her true self to no one but him.

[Original Web Novel](https://kakuyomu.jp/works/16818023211862649853)

items.title: Zatch Bell!!
items.overview:
Every 1000 years, 100 demon children are sent to Earth to compete in a battle to become king of the Demon World. Each demon is paired with a human partner who is given a spell book of a specific color. The human can cast the demon's spells through their book. If a demon's book is burned, they disappear and return to the Demon World. The last demon remaining becomes the king. The show is oriented around Gash Bell and his human partner, Takamine Kiyomaro.

But Akuto takes it to a new extreme with his condescending and self-important attitude.
